006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.library;
007
008import java.util.ArrayList;
009import java.util.List;
010import java.util.ListIterator;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
013import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathConstants;
014import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ComparisonFunctions;
015import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.FunctionUtils;
016import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IArgument;
017import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function.IFunction;
018import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.IItem;
019import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.ISequence;
020import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
021import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IIntegerItem;
022import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
023import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
024import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
025
026/**
027 * /** Implements <a href=
028 * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-index-of">fn:index-of</a>
029 * functions. This implementation does not implement the three-arg variant with
030 * collation at this time.
031 */
032public final class FnIndexOf {
033  @NonNull
034  private static final String NAME = "index-of";
035  @NonNull
036  static final IFunction SIGNATURE_TWO_ARG = IFunction.builder()
037      .name(NAME)
038      .namespace(MetapathConstants.NS_METAPATH_FUNCTIONS)
039      .deterministic()
040      .contextDependent()
041      .focusIndependent()
042      .argument(IArgument.builder()
043          .name("seq")
044          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
045          .zeroOrMore()
046          .build())
047      .argument(IArgument.builder()
048          .name("search")
049          .type(IAnyAtomicItem.type())
050          .one()
051          .build())
052      .returnType(IIntegerItem.type())
053      .returnZeroOrMore()
054      .functionHandler(FnIndexOf::executeTwoArg)
055      .build();
056
057  @SuppressWarnings("unused")
058  @NonNull
059  private static ISequence<IIntegerItem> executeTwoArg(@NonNull IFunction function,
060      @NonNull List<ISequence<?>> arguments,
061      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext,
062      IItem focus) {
063    ISequence<IAnyAtomicItem> seq = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(0)));
064    IAnyAtomicItem search = FunctionUtils.asType(ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(arguments.get(1).getFirstItem(true)));
065
066    return seq.isEmpty() ? ISequence.empty() : fnIndexOf(seq, search, dynamicContext);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Determine if the string provided in the first argument contains the string in
071   * the second argument as a substring.
072   * <p>
073   * Based on the XPath 3.1 <a href=
074   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-index-of">fn:index-of</a>
075   * function.
076   *
077   * @param items
078   *          the items to match against
079   * @param search
080   *          the item to match
081   * @param dynamicContext
082   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
083   *          timezone
084   * @return a list of index numbers indicating the position of matches in the
085   *         sequence
086   */
087  @NonNull
088  public static ISequence<IIntegerItem> fnIndexOf(
089      @NonNull List<IAnyAtomicItem> items,
090      @NonNull IAnyAtomicItem search,
091      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
092    int index = 0;
093    ListIterator<IAnyAtomicItem> iterator = items.listIterator();
094    List<IIntegerItem> indices = new ArrayList<>();
095    while (iterator.hasNext()) {
096      ++index;
097      IAnyAtomicItem item = iterator.next();
098      assert item != null;
099      // use the "eq" operator
100      try {
101        if (ComparisonFunctions.valueCompairison(item, ComparisonFunctions.Operator.EQ, search, dynamicContext)
102            .toBoolean()) {
103          // Offset for Metapath indices that start from 1
104          indices.add(IIntegerItem.valueOf(index));
105        }
106      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
107        // this is an effective false on the match
108      }
109    }
110    return ISequence.ofCollection(indices);
111  }
112
113  private FnIndexOf() {
114    // disable construction
115  }
116}
